package service

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

// This boundary observes Student and cannot write learner or Runtime state.
type HybridStudentSnapshotService interface {
	GetHybridPlanningSnapshot(context.Context, string, string, domain.HybridSnapshotRequest) (domain.HybridPlanningSnapshot, error)
}
